items.title: Z-index

items.description: If not covered by the disabled color roles.

items.title: Textarea

items.title: Select

items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Multiple choice.

items.title: Radio
items.description: Single choice.

items.title: Switch
items.description: On / off setting.

items.title: Badge
items.description: Small indicator (number or status). First uses: the counter of the Navigation item, and the version badge next to the title of the component pages (B096). A Tag (category, filter) would be a separate component, later. Note: change the color of the version badge (to define with the Design System Lead).

items.title: Alert
items.description: Feedback messages (success, warning, error, info).

items.title: Card
items.description: Content container, uses shadows. Used on the documentation site: home page links and backlog cards.

items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short contextual help.

items.title: Dialog
items.description: Dialog, uses the highest shadow. Opens the detail of a Level 3 page (e.g. a ticket from the Backlog) instead of a new page (Navigation structure page, B082).

items.title: Chip

items.title: Prototype: WorkDescription

iterations.feedback: Cards in the clickable-image version: all 4 cards, 3 images each (one row), neutral placeholder images. The prototype follows the new card skill. New screens to define next.

items.title: Version control (git)

items.title: Skill: component-spec
items.description: How to write a component design spec (stage 1): sections, level of detail, which tokens to reference, what to ask the Design System Lead.

items.title: Skill: component-guidelines

items.title: Skill: component-code
items.description: Coding rules for components (stage 3): React + TypeScript structure, semantic tokens only, ds- classes, state layers, props naming, examples file.

items.title: Skill: accessibility-check
items.description: WCAG 2.2 AA review of a component or prototype: contrast, keyboard, focus, screen reader, touch targets, reduced motion.

items.title: Skill: prototype-setup
items.description: Sets up a new prototype so it runs with the real React components (backlog item, folder from the template, title, imports, check). The screens are then built with the other skills.

items.title: Skill: token-usage
items.description: Which semantic token to pick for each need (text, background, border, spacing, text style…), with examples.

items.title: Skill: steps-log
items.description: How to write a STEPS.md entry: format, decisions vs actions, files changed. No dedicated skill: the rules are in CLAUDE.md and the git-workflow skill.

items.title: Skill: backlog-management
items.description: How to keep backlog/backlog.json up to date: statuses, stages, adding proposals, never starting a proposal. Covered by the backlog skill.

items.title: Side navigation
items.description: Define the side navigation as a design system component (4 stages). Starting point: the documentation site navigation (brand background, icons, sections, current page in cream).

items.title: Skill: component (main)
items.description: Entry point for every component: routes to the stage sub-skills and enforces the approval gate.

items.title: Skill: component-structure

items.title: Classify the backlog components by Atomic Design level

items.title: Templates and pages vs prototypes

items.title: Timeline: fill its 4 columns on desktop
items.description: Page-content rule: cards 8 columns, timeline 4 columns, 12-column grid on the full screen width. The Timeline fills its container (no 400px maximum on desktop); --size-timeline stays for the small-screen panel. Spec, guidelines and code approved 2026-10-21. TimelineStep: the date range goes under the title when the title would be narrower than --size-timeline-step-title (200px).

items.title: Component: ImageViewer
items.description: Opens an image larger, over the page, one at a time. Needed by the Card clickable-image variant (B078). Spec, guidelines and code approved 2026-10-23.

items.title: Card: clickable-image variant
items.description: Property variant = default | clickable-image; images { src, alt, caption?, thumbnailSrc? } as thumbnails under the text (3 per row, 16:9 cropped, radius-8, space-8 gap, space-16 under the text, no maximum); only the thumbnails are clickable and open the ImageViewer. Spec, guidelines and code approved 2026-10-27.

items.title: Git workflow: one branch per piece of work
items.description: Skill git-workflow: branches component/<Name>, prototype/<folder-name>, governance/<topic>; one folder and one Claude session per branch; steps numbered per ticket (Step B079-1); when and how a branch is merged into main; folders, branches and skill dispatch fully automatic (no manual action from the Design System Lead). Decided 2026-10-27.

items.title: Conversations and their usage
items.description: In the git-workflow skill: the conversations of the Claude project and their usage. Gouvernance (one, permanent, governance/<topic>), Composant <Name> and Prototype <Name> (one each, archived when finished). Decided 2026-10-27.

items.title: Skill: card

items.title: Documentation page: Navigation structure
items.description: Page of the documentation site (#/navigation), under Prototypes: navigation levels (Level 0 landing page to Level 4 component pages), flow, navigation principles (logo, breadcrumb, depth and modals, anchors and timeline) and what is still to define. Target structure: the site does not follow it yet.

items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Shows where the page sits in the navigation structure and goes back to any level above it (Navigation structure page, B082).

items.title: Dedicated agents for recurring checks
items.description: Reusable agents in .claude/agents/<name>.md (role, allowed tools, what to report) for checks that come back often, e.g. a token auditor that finds raw values in components. Only once a check is recurring.

items.title: Rules for agents in CLAUDE.md
items.description: Agents section in CLAUDE.md: agents read and propose only, never change tokens/, components/ or prototypes/; Claude checks their results before showing them; never-invent applies to agents. Decided 2026-10-27.

items.title: Skill: navigation
items.description: Navigation levels (Level 0 to Level 4), structure of the site and navigation principles (logo, breadcrumb, depth and modals, anchors and timeline), approved with the Navigation structure page (B082).

items.title: Site follows the navigation structure
items.description: The documentation site follows the navigation skill: landing page (one card per space: Documentation, Portfolio), spaces in the header, side navigation scoped to the current space, Overview / Governance / Foundations (one page per category) / Components (one page per Atomic Design level) / Prototypes / Navigation as sections of Documentation, Portfolio placeholder, logo to Level 0. Breadcrumb (B083) and modal (B029) come later, once they are components. Decided 2026-10-27.

items.title: Landing page illustrations
items.description: Illustrations of the landing page (Level 0): background motifs and a retouched avatar, kawaii style like the avatar, primary and secondary palettes only. Built in 3 steps. Decided 2026-10-27.

items.title: Work-time clock: keep the time of deleted conversations
items.description: The clock lost the hours of deleted conversations (their transcripts are removed). Baseline 08:50:14 on 2026-10-27 at 09:31 UTC, decided by the Design System Lead; active periods are kept in a ledger shared by all the conversations, so deleting one no longer removes time.

items.title: Breadcrumb item
items.description: Building block of the Breadcrumb (B083): one link to a level above the page. Done first. Decided 2026-10-28.

items.title: Site: breadcrumb on Level 2 to Level 4 pages
items.description: Use the Breadcrumb component (B083) on the documentation site, as its guidelines say: every page from Level 2 to Level 4, first block above the title; update the navigation skill and the Navigation structure page (the breadcrumb is now a component).

items.title: Tabs
items.description: Navigation within a page. Used on the documentation site: tabs of the component pages (Design preview, Design spec, Guidelines, Examples, Code).

Horizontal scroll when the chips do not fit (chosen while it was Tabs, to confirm). Replaces the chips of the documentation site (Backlog filter, Design preview variant switch).

items.title: Backlog page: changes saved to main
items.description: A change made by the Design System Lead on the Backlog page (approve, reject, status, stage) is saved where the page is served and also committed and pushed to main from the root folder, so it never stays on a work branch only.

items.title: Backlog: no proposals column, priorities

items.title: Git workflow: governance and component branches only
items.description: Two branch types only: governance/<topic> and component/<Name>. A prototype is worked on a component/<prototype-folder> branch, in a Composant <Name> conversation. Two conversation kinds: Gouvernance and Composant <Name>.

items.title: Live component playground (Storybook-like)
items.description: On each component page, show the coded React component live, like Storybook: a canvas with controls to change its props.

items.title: Backlog cleanup
items.description: Close the duplicate tickets (B071 to B074) and the tickets already covered by other work (B032, B042, B043, B100).

items.title: Playground: list of icons
items.description: In the Playground, the icon controls (Button, IconButton, NavigationItem) offer the list of every Material Symbols icon in a dropdown, instead of a text field.

items.title: Ticket description template
items.description: A fixed format for the description of every backlog ticket, shown in the ticket's modal on the Backlog page.
items.why: Ticket descriptions are free text of uneven length: the need, the content and when a ticket is finished are not always written.
items.scope: The template (Goal, Why, Scope, Done when), written by Claude when a ticket is created, and shown in a modal (Dialog) opened by a click on a ticket of the Backlog page. Not included: rewriting the descriptions of the existing tickets.
doneWhen: A click on a ticket of the Backlog page opens it in a modal, with Goal, Why, Scope and Done when.
The menus of a ticket (status, priority, release, stage) still work on its card without opening the modal, and are also in the modal.
The backlog skill asks for the template when a ticket is created.

items.title: Skill: ticket
items.description: A ticket skill: how to write a backlog ticket with the template, and what a prototype ticket must also contain.
items.why: The ticket template lives inside the backlog skill, and a prototype ticket needs more than the four parts to describe a user journey.
items.scope: The ticket skill (template, parts by type), the prototype parts (Users, User journey, Components used) in the ticket fields and in the ticket's modal, and the links from the backlog and orchestrator skills. Not included: filling these parts for the existing prototype tickets.
doneWhen: The ticket skill exists, is dispatched by the orchestrator and shown on the How to use skills page.
A prototype ticket shows Users, User journey and Components used in its modal.
The backlog skill refers to the ticket skill for the content of a ticket.

items.title: SelectOption
items.description: One option of the Select list. Building block of the Select (B021), built first.
